# Getting help

- **Using Halo:** the in-app Help page (`#/help`) covers the camera and microphone, light, distance, glasses and masks. The [README](../README.md) explains what it does and what it does not.
- **Trying it:** https://halo.dualmindlab.tech, or `./run.sh` to run it yourself.
- **Questions and ideas:** open a GitHub Discussion if they are enabled, otherwise an issue.
- **Bugs:** use the bug report template.
- **Wrong match:** use the "Wrong match report" template. Never attach photos of people.
- **Security:** see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

Halo is a prototype and not a medical device. It cannot be relied on to identify anyone.
